mapper.select:
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diary_media lock_dm JOIN diary lock_d ON lock_d.space_id=lock_dm.space_id AND lock_d.diary_id=lock_dm.diary_id WHERE lock_dm.space_id=a.space_id AND lock_dm.asset_id=a.asset_id AND lock_d.locked=1 ) AS protected_content, v.variant_type,v.profile,v.storage_provider,v.storage_key,v.content_type,v.size_bytes, v.checksum_sha256,v.width,v.height,v.duration_millis,v.quality_score,v.status FROM diary_space s
JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=s.space_id JOIN space_member m ON m.space_id=s.space_id AND m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
JOIN diary d ON d.space_id=s.space_id AND d.public_id=#{contextId} JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.space_id=d.space_id AND dm.diary_id=d.diary_id JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=dm.space_id AND a.asset_id=dm.asset_id JOIN space_member m ON m.space_id=s.space_id AND m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
JOIN album al ON al.space_id=s.space_id AND al.public_id=#{contextId} JOIN album_media am ON am.space_id=al.space_id AND am.album_id=al.album_id JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=am.space_id AND a.asset_id=am.asset_id JOIN space_member m ON m.space_id=s.space_id AND m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
JOIN anniversary an ON an.space_id=s.space_id AND an.public_id=#{contextId} JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=an.space_id AND a.asset_id=an.cover_asset_id JOIN space_member m ON m.space_id=s.space_id AND m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
JOIN user_avatar ua ON ua.space_id=s.space_id JOIN account target ON target.account_id=ua.account_id AND target.public_id=#{contextId} JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=ua.space_id AND a.asset_id=ua.asset_id
JOIN private_share ps ON ps.space_id=s.space_id AND ps.public_id=#{contextId} JOIN diary d ON d.space_id=ps.space_id AND d.diary_id=ps.diary_id JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.space_id=d.space_id AND dm.diary_id=d.diary_id JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=dm.space_id AND a.asset_id=dm.asset_id
JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id AND v.variant_type=#{type} AND v.profile=#{profile} AND v.status='READY' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.public_id=#{spaceId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.public_id=#{assetId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='READY'
AND (a.owner_id=#{accountId} OR a.access_scope='SPACE')
AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.visibility='SHARED' OR d.author_id=#{accountId})
AND al.deleted_at IS NULL AND an.deleted_at IS NULL
AND ps.revoked_at IS NULL AND ps.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
LIMIT 1
